title: Crospi Playground display names
description: Names shown in the dropdowns of the Crospi Playground instead of the file names. Keys: paths relative to the package directory. Only the labels change: files, task names and file_path references stay the same.

setups.description: Application setups (*.setup.json): Setup tabs and robot selector.

skills.description: Skill scripts (*.py) that are not examples of playground.json (list of skills of the Skill mode).

task_specifications.description: Task specifications (*.etasl.lua): Task specs tab of the Skill mode and Open… of the Task mode.
